stem.text: The graph shows the variation of the momentum $p$ with time $t$ for a car.

stem.alt: Graph of momentum p in units of 10^4 kg m s-1 against time t in seconds. The printed scale marks are 1 and 4 on the momentum axis and 0, 20, 50 and 60 on the time axis. The line rises from 1 at t = 0 to 4 at t = 20, stays at 4 until t = 50, then falls to 0 at t = 60.

stem.text: What is the resultant force on the car at $t = 10\,\text{s}$?
